summary: Paro district is dominated by forests, covering 605.80 km² (47.1%) of its area. The next largest land uses are meadows at 174.87 km² (13.6%) and alpine scrubs at 163.03 km² (12.7%). Smaller portions are devoted to shrubs (127.97 km², 10.0%) and other categories such as snow and glacier (69.77 km², 5.4%), agriculture land (68.78 km², 5.4%), and rocky outcrops (59.87 km², 4.7%).
